source.name: Community Berger 270 Caliber 170 Grain EOL Elite Hunter

loads.notes: Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Yoteklr; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; Cartridge is the thread. Un-fireformed brass. Seating test from .008 to .068 off; .068 jump grouped best in 35 mph wind out to 200 yards and he said he would retest. McGowen barrel returned at SAAMI freebore; he believes about .000 freebore

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Yoteklr; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; After fireforming. Groups under .6 moa at 200 yards. The same shooter, as 46and2 on Shooters' Forum, wrote gm215m primers and a 26 inch barrel for a 3190 fps RL33 load with the same group, and did not restate the charge: https://forum.accurateshooter.com/threads/iso-27-nosler-loads.3985205/

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Yoteklr; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; Velocity_fps: 3190 to 3200; No charge in this sentence. Same shooter as the 85.5 gr Rl33 at 3190 fps post

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: dotman; Posted: Apr 1, 2016; He did not post the charge. Average of 5 shots on a magneto speed. Forbes 24B, factory ER Shaw barrel, twist 1:10. Loaded .02 off the lands. Ogive 2.757. Stability trouble at the lower ladder charges; very slight primer flattening at his max and he did not load to the published max. Elevation less than 1000 ft. The 2232 ft/s figure is a Shooter-app value at 660 yards, not this load's muzzle velocity

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: djauofd; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; Printed velocity: 2,930; McGowen Precision Remage; twist 1-8; Sendero profile; roughly 70 degrees. The 3190 fps remark in the same post is about the 27 Nosler, not this load

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: mcr-85; Posted: Mar 31, 2026; Cartridge is the thread title; the post does not restate it. Built around the Matrix 165 before the 170 existed; twist 1-9. A reply asked how many grains and this post does not give a charge

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: J.B.; Posted: Mar 31, 2026; A little spicy; no charge stated for this speed; same rifle as the 3050 load; twist 1:8; Benchmark barrel

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: J.B.; Posted: Mar 31, 2026; Charge_gr: I think 63.0; Only bullet he used in that rifle for 9 years; Benchmark barrel; twist 1:8; long action; the charge is hedged with I think; had the same rifle up to 3100 fps and called that a little spicy, with no charge stated for that speed

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: 270vld; Posted: Apr 17, 2024; No pressure signs; powder not stated. K&P cut rifled 4 groove 8 twist #4 contour; Terminus Zeus long action

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: 270vld; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; He wrote VLD. A later reply says he had assumed those bullets were VLDs and they are Elite Hunters. Powder not stated. Brass necked down with a bushing, then over a turn mandrel
Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Darkside; Posted: May 23, 2024; Slight ejector marks. Same rifle and cartridge note as the N-570 row

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Darkside; Posted: May 23, 2024; Slight ejector marks. The load sentence does not restate the cartridge. Thread title is 270 RUM. The reamer sentence is 270/ 7RUM and the build sentence says that 27 was chambered. Douglas barrel, 8 twist, Sendero contour. Still early in development. 39 rounds fired during break-in, not all this load

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: yorketransport; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; Best velocity he got with the 170. Burned incredibly dirty and had pretty poor case fill. No grain charge stated. He stopped at a 3200 fps target and said the load could have been pushed harder. He also calls the barrels 27/338 RUM improved. The 165 gr Matrix in the 270 RUM is a different bullet

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: yorketransport; Posted: date not shown in the page fetch; Better case fill than the RL33 load. No grain charge stated. Same 25 inch barrel. He hit pressure with Retumbo at a very low case fill and gave no charge or velocity for that powder

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: tdhanses; Posted: Feb 3, 2019; Printed velocity: 3,040; Powder was named in a later reply, last edited May 10, 2019. Sweet spot between .08 and .1 jump; SD 4; ES 9; Proof sendero lite; LPA Razor-Ti short action; Large Rifle primers gave better velocity than magnum primers, brand not named; no charge stated

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: mtmojo; Posted: Feb 19, 2025; Tested with 170 Bergers. Cartridge is the thread title.
